title: Records for condensed exceptional reconstruction
statement: Fix a prime l and a field k of positive prime characteristic different from l. Let X,Y be separated finite-type quasi-compact k-schemes, f:X to Y a k-morphism, and c a compactification. All coefficient fields are the canonical universe lift of Q_l and its fixed algebraic closure. Use the integral and condensed constructible categories and actual reduction/limit functors of the dependencies below. A Context P records strict ordinary etale support, Brown and finite adjunctions, proetale site transport and normalized sequence presentations. A Datum consists of an integral L on Y, a strict derived varying-coefficient system M on X, and the specified finite exceptional identifications; Admissible means normalized quotient transitions, compatible level isomorphisms, supplied system theta or a common single degree, uniform intrinsic constructibility, and an actual integral total limit whose reductions recover M. Define SystemIdentification to consist of theta from M to the transported Brown output, retention of the supplied theta, its prescribed evaluations and a Brown lower bound, together with invertibility of the input reduction unit, Brown-origin unit and proper/open origin comparison. SystemRecognition chooses these identifications for admissible data and asserts that level squares between systems in one common degree imply the actual Brown-system map square. ComparisonNaturality and SingleDegreeCompatibility are the original morphism-square predicates. AtCompactification packages the comparison, naturality and degree clause. regular is the completed rank-one coefficient in degree zero; IntegralShiftClosed is stability of the integral predicate under actual ambient shifts and integralShift is its full-subcategory restriction. RealizationProperties records regular membership, the section-normalized coefficient inclusion and its normalized scalar-transpose isomorphism, and canonical normalized shift comparisons. condensedRefinement is the intrinsic proper/open refinement restricted to the bounded constructible category; exceptionalRefinement is its mate under the exact chosen upstream adjunctions. RefinementCompatibility is the system counit square and its realized mate square. specifiedSupport is the equality transport of the supplied ComparisonFamily member, and Family combines the realization properties, compactification comparisons and refinement compatibility. These definitions are verbatim moves from the parent except for the two intermediate system records. [def-pur-exceptional-reconstruction-context, def-pur-exceptional-reconstruction-comparison, def-pur-exceptional-realization-normalization, lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization].
